title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, the main character in the book got a lot of plushies too!
choice_data_list: Did I go a little overboard?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No, not at all! It's like my dream came true! I'm really happy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And if I manage to carry all these back home without dropping one…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Think of the effect it'll have on my core muscles! Talk about two birds with one stone!
